text:
Predicates:
OlympicGames(x) ::: x is an Olympic games.
SportingEvent(x) ::: x is a sporting event.
LastOlympicGames(x) ::: x is the last Olympic games.
HeldIn(x, y) ::: x was held in location y.
UnitedStates(x) ::: x is the United States.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in event y.
Tokyo(y) ::: y is Tokyo.
WorldChampionships(x) ::: x is a world championship.

Premises:
OlympicGames(x) ∧ SportingEvent(x) ::: The Olympic games is a sporting event.
LastOlympicGames(y) ∧ HeldIn(y, Tokyo) ::: The last Olympic games was in Tokyo.
UnitedStates(z) ∧ WonMostMedals(z, y) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.

Conclusion:
∃x (SportingEvent(x) ∧ x = worldChamps) ::: The world championships is a sporting event.
